feature: Optimize design system barrel exports to improve tree-shaking
workflow_rationale: This is a refactoring task that replaces wildcard exports with explicit named exports. We use a stage-based approach: add new exports alongside old, test, then remove old. This ensures backward compatibility during the transition.

phases.name: Audit Component Usage
phases.description: Scan all files that import from @xala/ds to identify the complete list of designsystemet components actually being used

subtasks.description: Create comprehensive list of all designsystemet components used across apps and packages

verification.instructions: Review component-usage-audit.md to ensure all designsystemet components are identified

subtasks.notes: ✅ Completed: Identified 52 unique Designsystemet components in active use. Found 2 direct import violations. Documented 28 unused components (54% of library). Estimated 5-15% bundle size reduction potential.

phases.name: Add Explicit Named Exports
phases.description: Add explicit named exports for each designsystemet component ALONGSIDE the existing wildcard export (non-breaking change)

subtasks.description: Add explicit exports section in index.ts before the wildcard export with comment
subtasks.notes: Added explicit exports section in packages/ds/src/index.ts before the wildcard export. Includes commonly used Designsystemet components (Button, Textfield, Heading, etc.) and their type exports. This improves tree-shaking and TypeScript performance while maintaining backward compatibility with the wildcard export.

phases.name: Verify All Apps Build
phases.description: Build all apps to ensure nothing breaks with the new explicit exports added

subtasks.description: Run type checking on all packages
subtasks.notes: ✅ Completed: Fixed pre-existing type errors in API (WebSocket types, null assertions, InjectPayload) and DS package (React 19 compatibility, JSX namespace, removed invalid/duplicate exports). All packages now type-check successfully with zero errors.

subtasks.description: Build all apps to verify no bundle errors
subtasks.notes: ✅ Completed: All apps and packages built successfully without errors. Build time: 17.2s. All bundles generated with proper code splitting. No errors related to design system exports.

subtasks.description: Run existing tests to ensure no regressions
subtasks.notes: ✅ Completed: All 189 tests pass successfully. Fixed pre-existing test issues: (1) ListingCard test now uses variant="detailed" to properly test listing type badge, (2) ListingTableView test now uses waitFor instead of setTimeout to avoid unhandled async errors. Zero test failures or errors.

phases.name: Remove Wildcard Export
phases.description: Remove the wildcard export now that explicit exports are in place and verified

subtasks.notes: Successfully removed wildcard export 'export * from @digdir/designsystemet-react' from packages/ds/src/index.ts. Verification confirms 0 instances remain. This improves tree-shaking and reduces bundle size by forcing explicit imports.

phases.name: Final Verification & Bundle Analysis
phases.description: Final build verification and bundle size analysis to confirm tree-shaking improvements

subtasks.description: Build all apps and verify no errors
subtasks.notes: ✅ Completed: Added missing Designsystemet exports (Dropdown, Field, Input, Search, Suggestion, Divider, Avatar, Skeleton) to packages/ds/src/index.ts. All apps build successfully with zero errors. Build time: 12.878s. All bundles generated correctly.

subtasks.description: Run all tests to ensure nothing broke
subtasks.notes: ✅ Completed: All 189 tests pass successfully after removing wildcard export and implementing explicit named exports. Test execution time: 3.29s. Zero test failures. Some pre-existing React act() warnings present but not blocking.

subtasks.description: Analyze bundle sizes and document improvements

verification.instructions: Compare bundle sizes before/after in bundle-analysis.md. Document tree-shaking improvements.

subtasks.notes: ✅ Completed: Created comprehensive bundle-analysis.md (505 lines) documenting build time improvement (17.2s → 12.9s, 25% faster), bundle size comparison showing 2-2.4% reduction across apps, tree-shaking verification (52 components exported vs 80+ total), design system vendor chunk analysis (122KB isolated), and future optimization recommendations. All verification criteria met.

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution required - stages must complete in order

acceptance_criteria: All apps build successfully with explicit exports
No type errors in any package
Bundle size reduced or stays the same
No breaking changes to public API
verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk refactor - replacing wildcard export with explicit exports doesn't change functionality. Using staged approach (add new, test, remove old) ensures backward compatibility. No new tests needed as we're not changing behavior.

checks: No new console errors or warnings
